verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (logo, product, headline, copy, CTA), but the logo floats off-axis from the 25px text edge, the CTA is indented about 20px from the copy column, the box drifts off its circle and the legal line is too small to read. B moves the CTA to the top-left corner, crammed beside the logo and read before the headline it supports, which breaks reading order and hierarchy. It also leaves a dead empty band at the bottom, and its legal text is just as unreadable.
